Emilia Setup


## What's Changed

###  New Features & Enhancements
• **Service Unavailable (503) Dialog**：Added automatic detection of Character.AI service outages / 503 errors and a dedicated popup notification dialog informing users when the service is under heavy load.
• **Linux Updater & Improved Reliability**：Reworked the updater mechanism with SHA-256 integrity checks, cross-platform path resolution, and support for updating on Linux.
• **Updated Character.AI Models**：Refreshed the list of available models (`CAI_Available_Models.json`).

### Bug Fixes & Stability
• **WebSocket Connection Fixes**：Fixed WebSocket reconnect logic, added proper request headers, origin verification, and updated browser impersonation (`chrome150`).
• **User Profile & Account Crash Fixes**：Safe parsing of user account data (preventing crashes if account details or avatar fields are missing).
• **Character Voting Fix**：Fixed character like/dislike toggle states and callbacks.
• **Dynamic Versioning**：Robust version lookup (`VERSION` file) compatible with PyInstaller bundles, installer setups, and source runs.

### Technical & Dependencies
• **Dependency Cleanup**：Removed `Pillow` dependency, updated `curl_cffi` (0.17.0), `livekit` (1.2.0), `websockets` (17.3), `pyqt6`, `pydantic`, `numpy`, and `scipy`.
• **CI/CD Cleanup**：Consolidated build workflows into a unified `build.yml` and removed deprecated batch scripts (`update.bat`).

**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/Kajitsy/Emilia/compare/3.3.5...3.3.6
